title: Villa by the Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Escape to this idyllic coastal getaway, offering the perfect retreat for you and your loved ones. Step inside and embrace relaxation in the spacious living room, adorned with soft seating and featuring a large TV for your entertainment. The adjacent kitchen is a dream for any chef, equipped with stainless steel appliances and ample space for meal preparation. Enjoy your meals at the breakfast bar, or the formal dining table, or dine alfresco on the beautiful balcony, immersing yourself in the coastal ambiance. Rest assured that your loved ones will also find comfort in the home's three additional bedrooms, where soft bedding and central air-conditioning provide a cool and inviting atmosphere. Take advantage of the private washer/dryer to keep your clothes fresh during your stay, adding to the convenience of the home. Conclude your evenings in one of the home's scenic outdoor spaces, where you can soak in ocean views and create cherished memories with your loved ones. Let the soothing coastal breeze and breathtaking scenery enhance your vacation experience, leaving you with unforgettable moments to treasure.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Two Single Over Double Bunks
